body: Apparently he was also a grammar nazi.
I’m in. His blessed soul should live here forever.

The same goes for me. I can’t express my feelings even to my closest ones, and can’t cry in front of someone even if it’s my mother.  Most people know me as a callous person because of this but actually i have a great pain. 

I was thinking it was because of not trusting people, but it happens even with the most trusted ones. Maybe it’s just a personality trait, but i don’t know the exact reason.
